transcript.text: These photos are all different shapes. Make one 10-second vertical reel, in this order. Keep each whole photo visible—don't stretch or crop them. Use a soft blurred background to fill the gaps. No music or text.

Before I make this, I need you to pick an option. There's one part of your request I can't do exactly.

The problem is the blurred background. My tools can show a photo unchanged, whole and uncropped, but only on a plain solid colour. None of them can put an exact photo on top of a blurred copy of itself. The only way to get a blurred fill is to have the AI image editor redraw each photo onto a tall 9:16 frame. That means it may change, crop or redraw details in your photos, and I can't promise it won't. That goes against your "keep each whole photo" rule.

Your options for the 10-second vertical reel (5 photos × 2 s, in your order: storefront → latte → pastries → barista → interior, no music, no text):

1. **Exact photos on a plain background.** Every photo shows whole and unchanged, centred on a solid colour you choose (for example black, white or a warm café brown). To do this I first copy each photo to a link the video tool can read, which costs about 25 credits per photo, so about 100 more credits. (The storefront photo is already done.)
2. **AI blurred fill.** The AI redraws each photo onto a 9:16 frame with a soft blurred fill. It's about 5 credits per photo, but the photos may come out slightly changed. The images are made at 640 px, the size the free plan allows.

Which one should I make? If you pick option 1, tell me the background colour too.
transcript.why: The reply asks the user to choose between two options ("Which one should I make?") and waits for the answer. It does not deliver a result, ask for approval of a spend, or refuse.

transcript.text: Option 1, please. Keep the whole photos unchanged. Background colour is your call. Yes, go ahead with the credits.

Your reel is done: http://127.0.0.1:8000/films/0cd4d397fe9742c084c1b76aad6c7ff7.mp4

- **Format:** vertical 9:16 (480×854), exactly 10 seconds, no sound.
- **Order:** storefront → latte → pastries → barista → interior, 2 seconds each.
- **Background:** near-black (#111111), so the photos stand out.
- **Photos:** none were redrawn by AI. Each one is shown as a still and fitted onto the frame.
- **Not yet checked:** I couldn't look at the finished video myself. Please confirm that each whole photo shows with no cropping and that the order is right.
- **Credits:** 130 in total. That's 125 to copy the 5 photos to links the video tool could read (25 each), and 5 for a test of the AI blurred-fill version before you picked option 1.
transcript.why: The reply presents a finished result: a video link, plus its format, order, and background. It includes caveats (not visually checked, asks the user to confirm cropping and order) and reports credits already spent. It does not ask a question to proceed, request approval for new spending, or decline.
